provenance.derivation_note: PMMA-phantom series of the Aschan et al. (TECDOC-1223) FIG. 3 digitization, re-homed under the canonical metric name so the comparison binds it to the PMMA-phantom computed report (openbnct.beam-quality.fir1-k63-pmma.v1) rather than the water phantom's. Phantom: cylindrical PMMA (C5H8O2), diameter 20 cm, length 24 cm, 14 cm aperture, 250 kW scale, 13% stated 1sigma plus digitization allowance — see fir1-k63-cylindrical-phantom-depth.json for the full digitization and interpolation conventions.

measurements.note: PMMA phantom series (detector stations 0.2, 1.0, 2.0, 2.5, 3.0, 6.0, 10.0, 15.0 cm). Phantom-qualified metric: recorded for completeness, not compared against the water-phantom computed profile.
